title: Basilisk Knight

additionalFacts.text: Complete The Fremennik Exiles to kill Basilisk Knights.
support: requiring level 60 Slayer and completion of The Fremennik Exiles to kill

additionalFacts.text: Equip a mirror shield or V's shield to avoid heavy damage and stat drain.
support: must equip a mirror shield or V's shield when fighting these monsters or they will take heavy damage and their stats will be drained
